technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Cloud Stream's TestSupportBinder abstraction to allow testing channel bindings and configuration properties without live middleware.
Utilize Spring Data Redis's RedisSentinelConfiguration to enable Sentinel cluster master/replica discovery for Redis message binder.
Refactor Spring XD trigger module into a standard Spring Cloud Stream source application starter.
Expose YARN container deployment parameters via Spring Cloud Deployer parameter mapping mechanisms into YARN Application Master environment.
Integrate Admin UI static assets into the Spring Cloud Data Admin server via Spring Boot web auto-configuration and REST endpoint mapping.
assumptions: Development and testing will be performed by a single developer familiar with the Spring Cloud ecosystem.
Target environment baseline assumes Java 17+ and Spring Boot / Spring Cloud compatible versions.
The existing Admin UI client assets are available and only require server-side integration and proxy/CORS configuration.
Integration test environments (e.g., YARN cluster access, Redis Sentinel instance) are available for developer testing.

activities.activity_name: Implement Spring Cloud Stream Module Test Support Framework
activities.activity_description: Create test binder implementation, message assertion helpers (Hamcrest/AssertJ integration), and testing infrastructure for module wiring and @ConfigurationProperties validation without external message buses (U1).

activities.activity_name: Investigate YARN Distributed Deployment & Design YARNModuleDeployer
activities.activity_description: Investigate YARN SPIs, research distributed deployment patterns for Spring Cloud Stream modules on Hadoop YARN, and design YARNModuleDeployer strategy (U2).

activities.activity_name: Migrate Trigger Module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream
activities.activity_description: Port the trigger module code from Spring XD into the Spring Cloud Stream repository, update dependencies, align with new binder model, and add tests (U3).

activities.activity_name: Implement Redis Sentinel Cluster Support in Redis Message Binder
activities.activity_description: Enhance Redis message binder configuration to support Redis Sentinel master discovery, nodes configuration, and connection factory setup for stream and batch pipelines (U4).

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Receptor Client and Adapt API Integration
activities.activity_description: Update receptor-client library dependency in Spring Cloud Data Flow and refactor integration code to comply with breaking changes in latest Receptor API (U5).

activities.activity_name: Integrate Admin UI Client with Spring Cloud Data Admin
activities.activity_description: Configure Spring Cloud Data Admin server to host and serve existing Admin UI client, including CORS, configuration endpoints, and security mappings (U6).
Create Spring Boot auto-configuration classes and conditional properties for single-node binder setup, and update spring.factories/configuration metadata (U7).

activities.activity_name: Implement Parameter Passing for YARN Containers
activities.activity_description: Extend YARN deployer to accept definition parameters and pass them through YARN ApplicationMaster into launch arguments for container-run modules (U8).

activities.activity_name: System Integration Testing, Documentation, and Verification
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end integration testing across components, verify build pipelines, update documentation, and prepare release candidate artifacts.
